title: Blue Hour and Postcards
author: C. M. Okafor
blurb: Noor Halloran, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
